body:
Product (claude-product-15) back after token outage. No landings for ~40h (newest 2390m ago). Loop workers already restarted 10:15/10:16 on aa567732 (BUG-2703 live), so the pending restart is done.
`aida land stalls` shows 4 stuck, all waiting on advisor routing:
- #4385 BUG-2707 bdd60daf (R4 FINAL head), changes requested, fast gates + Build red, no lane for 2314m. Round cap is 4: park it or grant a narrow exception?
- #4388 BUG-2688 d49e9506, round 3, all CI red, no lane for 740m. Route r4?
- #4387 TASK-3133 509f5afb CONFLICTING, unowned for 2423m. Acceptance evidence is already satisfied; needs a codex conflict-repair lane.
- #4376 BUG-2669 docs proposal 190513dc, CI red, no reviewer for 2434m.
Product next: TASK-3173 (reviewer-model evidence from the first admitted review-watch launch) and the draft inbox (40 drafts, ~10 of them auto "Review PR-N" stories). Tell me which lanes to launch and I'll fill dell1.
subject: Product back: 4 stuck PRs need routing, 40h no landings
